sections.subtitle: Reusable analytics delivery IP for bringing predictions and risk scores into your Power BI reporting.

backgroundImage.alt: Analytics dashboard imagery illustrating predictive business reporting

sections.heading: Make model outputs usable in Power BI
sections.body:
Power BI + AI/ML brings reusable analytics delivery IP to model-output integration and reporting. Linkfields adapts this IP to the decision; Microsoft Power BI supplies the reporting platform, not Linkfields-owned platform functionality.

An existing model can supply the outputs, or model development can be scoped separately through the [Predictive Analytics Suite](/products-and-accelerators/predictive-analytics-suite). [Assess your predictive reporting use case](#get-in-touch): share the report, intended decision, Power BI environment and whether a model already exists.

sections.heading: Start with the decision, then the dashboard
sections.description: Reuse avoids starting each reporting integration from a blank design; the data contract, report configuration and acceptance tests remain client-specific.

sections.note: Historical demand and a model forecast → actual and forecast comparison for an agreed horizon → a planner reviews assumptions and model limitations → a stock or capacity decision is recorded. This is an engagement example, not an actual dashboard screenshot or measured client result.

sections.heading: What your Power BI environment needs
sections.description: First value is a report that users can interpret and accept. Model availability, data contracts, licensing, refresh and access controls determine the delivery plan.

items.title: Platform and data
items.description: Confirm that the reporting environment can support the intended use and data access.
items.bullets:
Agree – Power BI licensing and capacity
Check – data permissions and source access
Define – refresh mode and reporting scope

items.title: Model source and hosting
items.description: Decide whether the model is already available or needs a separate development scope.
items.bullets:
Identify – model owner and output contract
Agree – hosting and integration boundary

items.title: Security and support
items.description: Keep access and ownership clear across reports, data and model outputs.
items.bullets:
Agree – permissions and row-level security
Test – refresh and authorised access
Name – report, model and support owners

sections.note: Accelerator adoption is scoped separately from software licensing. Agree the engagement model, reuse and handover rights, licence dependencies and ongoing support before delivery.
